scripts.build: npm run build -w client -- && npm run build -w desktop && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w cli
scripts.lint: oxlint client/src client/.storybook common/src tools/src crosspoint-tools/src cli/src desktop/src desktop/scripts server/src scripts
scripts.server: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm start -w server --
scripts.android: npm run build -w client && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:install: npm run build -w client && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.ios: npm run build -w client && cd ios && xcodebuild -project nexlibris.xcodeproj -scheme nexlibris -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build build
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm start -w desktop
